entities.name: Leunclavius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes Leunclavius was a German historian and orientalist. He was an expert in Turkish history, republishing and annotating Ottoman sources. He also edited Xenophon, Cassius Dio, and other classical authors.
